description:
Fit a discrete linear A, B, and dt from logged (t, u, y) samples.

This tool stays free when payment enforcement is on. It does not call
IPOPT. Pass the returned matrices to ``solve_mpc`` as a linear system.
Send 4 to 2000 samples. Each ``y`` has length 1..24 and each ``u`` has
length 1..12, the same widths on every row, all finite, with strictly
increasing timestamps. Anything else is rejected before the fit.

request.description: Logged (t, u, y) samples for a free discrete linear fit. No X-API-Key and no x402 charge. Pass A, B, and dt to solve_mpc after a free validate_problem.

samples.description: Logged (t, u, y) rows. Length 4 to 2000. This fit is free: no X-API-Key and no x402 charge.

items.description: One logged sample. ``u`` and ``y`` are scalars or vectors.

t.description: Sample time. Must be finite, and strictly increasing from row to row. Use one time unit for the whole log.

u.description: Input sample, length 1 to 12. A scalar is wrapped as a one-element list. Every row uses the same length.

y.description: Output sample, length 1 to 24. A scalar is wrapped as a one-element list. Every row uses the same length.

name: identify_discrete_plant
title: Identify a discrete plant
